title: Internal: Closing Personal Checking Accounts
summary: This document explains how to close Internal personal checking accounts, including pre-closure checks (account must be OPEN, no pending transactions, and fee balance rules) and tier-based early closure fees: $15/30 days (Entry), $25/60 days (Mid), $50/90 days (Premium), $100/$180 days (Elite) with notice periods of 0/3/7/14 days respectively. It states the closure fee is deducted directly from the account balance with no alternative payment method, and closure is performed using close_bank_account_7392 after verification.
